name: Medical claim (paid by the company direct)
authority: WTAX: a reimbursement or direct payment of medical expenses is "actual medical assistance", de minimis to ₱10,000 / ₱12,000 a year (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(f)); the excess joins the ₱90,000 pool.
